title: BIR told: Send P203-B Marcos tax bill before Dec. 2 deadline

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) should send a new demand letter to Marcos heirs before Dec. 2 this year to ask them to pay their estate taxes liability worth P203 billion, lest the allowable collection period for the taxman expires which would result in loss of public revenue, a political coalition said on Friday. 1Sambayan urged newly appointed BIR Commissioner Rolando Ligon Jr. to issue and ensure the proper service and receipt of the demand letter on the Marcos heirs before the applicable prescription period expires. The BIR’s last written demand was issued on December 2, 2021. READ: BIR […]... Keep on reading: BIR told: Send P203-B Marcos tax bill before Dec. 2 deadline
